title: PT Indo Tambangraya Megah
description: PT Indo Tambangraya Megah, founded in 1987, is a leading coal producer based in Asia. The company focuses on maintaining high standards in corporate governance, environmental practices, and workplace safety. PT Indo Tambangraya Megah operates with a commitment to collaboration with local communities and stakeholders. The company has established a diverse customer base in the mining industry and offers various services related to coal production.
